$comment: Every app/edge source file that writes job_assignments or timesheets, or calls an assignment-writing RPC. Pinned by tests/assignments/assignment-writer-inventory.test.ts: a new writer, a new kind of write in a listed file, or a stale entry fails the build. Assignment membership/role/status/schedule changes belong to the command layer; anything else must say why it is not one. See docs/staffing/ASSIGNMENT_COMMANDS.md §7.

src/features/assignments/commands/client.reason: The assignment command layer itself: the only client entry point for membership, role, status and schedule changes.

supabase/functions/staffing-click/index..reason: Offer acceptance: atomic RPC under the same technician/pair lock order, with cross-job conflicts enforced under the lock (P0409).

src/services/toggleTimesheetDay.ts.reason: Thin RPC wrapper with no app caller left; kept for the env-gated real-stack test harness. The RPC takes the pair lock.

src/hooks/useTimesheets.ts.reason: Payroll timesheet page: hours, signatures, approvals and manual payroll rows of an existing assignment. Not assignment state; drift shows in get_assignment_consistency_issues.

src/hooks/useTechnicianRateModeDates.ts.reason: Hourly-rate override days for payroll (source hourly_rate_override).

src/components/dashboard/DateTypeContext.reason: Job-calendar date type off/travel voids or restores every technician's row for that date; a job-level operation, not one assignment.

src/services/deleteJobAssignments.ts.reason: Job deletion: the job itself is going away (foreign keys cascade).

supabase/functions/background-job-deleti.reason: Background job deletion: the job itself is going away.
